title: Hacktober 2026
description: A nine-hour team coding marathon where participants from our college and institutions across the region come together to transform ideas into innovative, real-world solutions. Teams work continuously on a given problem statement or choose from a set of challenges to develop a functional prototype within nine hours. Evaluation rounds assess different aspects of the project; the team with the highest cumulative score wins the championship title.
eligibility: Students from Rajkiya Engineering College, Azamgarh, and institutions across the region.
prizes: The team with the highest cumulative score across all evaluation rounds receives the championship title.
rules: Teams may have up to 10 people in total, including the leader.
The coding marathon lasts nine hours on 30 October 2026. Session start and end times will be announced.
Work on the provided problem statement or choose from the announced challenges.
Develop a functional prototype within the nine-hour timeframe.
Projects are assessed in multiple evaluation rounds on different aspects of the solution.
The highest cumulative score across all evaluation rounds determines the winner.
objectives: Build practical solutions to real-world problems.
Collaborate, code and innovate as a team.
Transform an idea into a functional prototype within nine hours.

faqs.a: A college-level, team-based coding marathon that brings developers, innovators and problem solvers together to build innovative solutions to real-world problems at REC Azamgarh. Build. Innovate. Compete.

faqs.q: When and where does it take place?
faqs.a: 30 October 2026 at Rajkiya Engineering College, Azamgarh. Duration: nine hours. Session start and end times will be announced.

faqs.q: How many people can join a team?
faqs.a: Up to 10 people in total: one leader and up to nine other students. The leader creates the team in the leader portal.
Teams work on a given problem statement or choose from the announced challenges, collaborate continuously and develop a functional prototype within the nine-hour timeframe.
The hackathon has multiple evaluation rounds assessing different aspects of each project. The final winner has the highest cumulative score across all rounds.

faqs.q: What does the winning team receive?

faqs.a: Register directly on the official MLH event page. Follow MLH’s sign-in and registration instructions. Hacktober registration does not use the Coding Club UPI payment form.
